result.title: Pretraining Representation Lottery Determines Fine-tuning Generalization
result.summary: Large scale pretraining (PT) followed by fine-tuning (FT) is the central paradigm of modern deep learning, yet how PT shapes FT generalization remains poorly understood. We use a synthetic setup in which the ground-truth concept geometry of entities is known, as a controlled testbed to study how representational geometry affects model behavior and how PT representations determine FT generalization. We first show that models differing only in training seed can closely match in PT loss yet vary substantially in FT generalization. We hypothesize that a representational lottery underlies this phenomenon: the random seed dependent geometry formed during PT determines what FT can reach. We confirm this causally. First, injecting the ground-truth concept geometry into the model yields near-ceiling FT generalization, showing that good representations directly drive generalization. Then, distilling a lucky seed's learned representation into an unlucky seed unlocks FT generalization, while distilling the same model's behavior does not. Furthermore, representation distillation can merge entities that never interacted during PT, which FT alone cannot. Finally, we show that regularizing representational drift during FT enables naturalistic learning: only models with good representations learn the task, and they generalize, while models with poor representations fail to fit it. Under plain FT, by contrast, models with poor representations fit the training objective by reshaping their pretrained representations. We reproduce the distillation result in Pythia-160M and Pythia-410M, each pretrained multiple times with different random seeds, and show that the transferable representation lives in the deep layers at both scales. Overall, PT acts as a lottery over representations, and the representation a model draws determines how it adapts during FT in a way that behavior alone does not explain.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在已知概念几何的合成任务上比较不同随机种子的预训练与微调，提出「表示抽签」假设，并用注入真实概念几何、把「幸运种子」的表示蒸馏给「不幸种子」、以及在微调期约束表示漂移等干预，论证预训练形成的表示几何因果地决定微调泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其表示蒸馏与漂移正则可作为训练监督线索，供核查能否把任务必要信息的几何结构注入 LVR 的内部状态，而「表示而非行为决定下游可达能力」的框架也可能类比 latent 内容是否真正被使用的问题。
